stages.title: Bootstrap control pack and repository run
stages.goal: Create a persistent workflow ledger, validate the control pack, and capture repository state.
instructions: Run controller init against the repository root.
Run controller verify-pack.
Create an artifact namespace for this refactor run.
Record repository HEAD, branch, and dirty state without modifying the tree.

stages.title: Discover actual repository seams and produce change map
stages.goal: Identify the canonical Graphify path and the narrowest attachment points before editing code.
instructions: Run scripts/repo_probe.py as a discovery aid.
Inspect and confirm the canonical Graphify entrypoint, provider loaders, spaCy owner, relation stack, gates, stores, graph writer, ledger, tests, and configuration.
Create a retained/extended/replaced/removed change map.
Populate .agent_state/extraction_scope.json from the template with repository-relative paths.

stages.title: Capture executable Relex baseline on both fixtures
stages.goal: Create immutable quality, speed, count, identity, and environment evidence for the current path.
instructions: Run current extraction tests before modification.
Run the existing Relex Graphify path over both fixtures twice.
Persist reports, logs, stage timings, counts, identity digests, model/config hashes, and graph verification evidence.
Confirm repeated baseline counts and identity digests are stable.

stages.title: Run gold-entity deterministic relation ceiling kill switch
stages.goal: Measure the maximum relation-pair recall of the complete deterministic syntax stack with perfect entity spans.
instructions: Feed quality-fixture gold mentions into the current complete relation stack.
Measure pair recall, directed pair recall, canonical predicate accuracy, directed triple recall, and open-relation recall.
Write facts.gold_pair_recall as a numeric value in the receipt.
Do not continue under an unmeasured syntax-only assumption.

stages.title: Implement zero-model survey, normalized offset space, and typed contracts
stages.goal: Create the corpus-derived signals and durable contracts assumed by the new architecture.
instructions: Implement the no-model survey for furniture, headings, aliases/acronyms, shapes, frequency features, and weak gazetteer candidates.
Implement one normalized character space with reversible original offsets.
Create or extend typed/versioned contracts for documents, windows, raw mentions, document entities, completed mentions, surface relations, assertions, receipts, and benchmark results.
Keep the canonical entity-type inventory frozen.

stages.title: Install the sole CPU-only GLiNER2 entity provider
stages.goal: Wire one warm fastino/gliner2-base-v1 CPU provider into the canonical Graphify path without fallback.
instructions: Use versioned natural-language entity descriptions.
Assert all model parameters/tensors are on CPU.
Load one model instance per Graphify process.
Keep Relex only in the isolated offline baseline runner.
Run scripts/check_cpu_policy.py against the populated extraction scope.

stages.title: Implement corpus-batched entity census and raw mention conservation
stages.goal: Run batched entity-only inference, preserve exact offsets, and persist immutable raw mentions before gating.
instructions: Create structure-aware census windows, length-bucket them, and batch on CPU with initial size 8.
Preserve deterministic input/output ordering.
Validate local, normalized-document, and original-source offsets.
Persist every raw mention or explicit alignment failure.
Prohibit spaCy, embeddings, graph writes, and other model inference during this stage.

stages.title: Implement document-local entity clustering and quality adjudication
stages.goal: Convert raw mentions into promoted, document-local, review, or suppressed document entities without destructive loss.
instructions: Cluster document-locally with context, type, definitions, aliases, headings, domain, and neighboring evidence.
Use recurrence and word frequency only as supporting signals.
Allow strong singletons and impose no hard document entity cap.
Persist terminal reducer state and reasons for every aligned raw mention.
Prove reducer conservation and repeatability.

stages.title: Implement document-local PhraseMatcher/EntityRuler mention completion
stages.goal: Recover all exact local occurrences of promoted document entities while protecting ambiguous ordinary-word uses.
instructions: Compile canonical names, aliases, acronyms, and variants into document-local matchers.
Create distinct mention records with exact offsets for every recovered occurrence.
Add context rules for ambiguous names such as Go, Make, Apple, Python, Oracle, and Rust.
Measure completion precision, recall, and deterministic IDs.

stages.title: Implement relation eligibility, parse-once syntax path, surface records, and predicate compiler
stages.goal: Generate high-precision local relation candidates without document-wide all-pairs expansion.
instructions: Persist relation-eligibility decisions and reasons.
Use one spaCy Doc per eligible text through nlp.pipe with statistical NER disabled.
Run DependencyMatcher, FrameExtractor, SVO, dep-path, voice, negation, modality, attribution, apposition, coordination, relative-clause, and nominalization logic on that Doc.
Persist durable surface-predicate records before canonical mapping.
Compile predicate maps and endpoint signatures once at startup and abstain when mapping is ambiguous.
Track relation-eligible rate and p50/p95/p99/max pair tails.
Run scripts/check_parse_once.py.

stages.title: Implement bounded GLiNER2 CPU semantic relation rescue
stages.goal: Recover relation recall selectively while bounding neural relation cost.
instructions: Use the same GLiNER2 Base CPU checkpoint.
Trigger only with promoted endpoints plus relation cues when grammar found no usable pair or mapping is ambiguous.
Enforce an initial 15% relation-eligible-window budget; overflow is DEFERRED_SEMANTIC_RESCUE.
Align semantic endpoints to promoted local mentions and keep semantic-only candidates review-only until calibrated.
Measure activation rate, precision, rescued true triples, cost, and backlog.

stages.title: Integrate staged execution into the canonical Graphify entrypoint
stages.goal: Connect all stages through resumable, fail-closed, idempotent Graphify orchestration and receipts.
instructions: Preserve the public Graphify entrypoint.
Emit input/output hashes, release pins, timings, counts, errors, warnings, conservation checks, status, and retry metadata at every stage.
Fail closed without projecting partial canonical facts.
Prove deterministic resume and duplicate prevention.

stages.title: Run canonical two-document E2E, graph rebuild, and idempotency suite
stages.goal: Prove connected behavior and collect comparable quality and speed evidence.
instructions: Populate .agent_state/run_config.json from the template with actual repository commands.
Run scripts/run_e2e.py.
Process both committed Markdown fixtures through the canonical Graphify entrypoint twice.
Run the frozen baseline where configured.
Delete and rebuild the isolated graph projection from authoritative records.
Verify exact evidence, directions, qualified claims, open relations, rejected junk, uniqueness, and identity/count digests.
Evaluate reports through scripts/evaluate_result.py.

stages.title: Remove retired live provider routes and update documentation
stages.goal: Leave one production extraction path while preserving one isolated executable Relex baseline runner.
instructions: Remove live ordinary GLiNER, GLiREL, and Relex provider routes, aliases, fallbacks, eager loads, and dead switches.
Retain historical reports and the offline baseline runner.
Update architecture, operations, dependencies, and provider manifests.
Run CPU/provider cleanup scans and unaffected regression tests.

stages.title: Run final verification and emit completion status
stages.goal: Verify every structural, quality, speed, conservation, rebuild, and idempotency gate and report remaining release boundaries.
instructions: Run all relevant unit, integration, E2E, policy, conservation, rebuild, idempotency, and unaffected regression tests.
Generate final JSON and Markdown reports.
Do not promote production graph writes solely from fixture results.
State held-out qualification and graph-write promotion accurately.
